title: Pulled Pork Nachos with Pepper Jack
description: Sheet pan nachos with leftover pulled pork. Serves 1 to 2.

ingredients.item: toppings: candied jalapenos, sour cream, BBQ sauce drizzle, ranch

steps: Preheat oven on Air Fry mode to 375°F. Line a sheet pan with foil.
Warm the pork in the microwave, covered, with a splash of juice or water, 1 to 2 min.
Spread chips in a single, slightly overlapping layer. Scatter half the cheese, all the pork, then the rest of the cheese. (For more cheese in every bite, do 2 thinner layers.)
Bake 4 to 7 min until the cheese is melted and bubbly. Watch closely, chip edges burn fast in this mode.
Top with candied jalapenos, dollops of sour cream, and a drizzle of BBQ sauce. Eat right away.
source: Joe's Meal Pack, Oct 20 to Nov 4, 2026 (built by Thrifty, now kept by Meal Plan), R21

not_healthy: Tortilla chips and pepper jack add fat and sodium.
Sour cream and ranch add saturated fat.
BBQ sauce and candied jalapenos add sugar.
